source: RFC 0014 R3 (the maintainer's word of 2026-11-24 on the kind through login, tokens, verifiers and the header, “同意”); the R3 design page v2, §B
statement: A login declares whose the token it issues is: TokenSubject.kind, PERSON or WORKLOAD, a required parameter with no default, so every Authentication says which for every principal it signs in (a social sign-in is a person's). CoSec's issuer writes it into every access token as the claim `cosec.kind`, `person` or `workload`, and into no refresh token; a client must not depend on it (contract/token/claims.json).
guards: jwt:JwtTokenConverterTest#the access token says whose it is, and the refresh token does not - IDN-45
login:TokenSubjectTest#a subject's kind is part of it, and its session keeps it - IDN-45
